notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 future-input Flush Queue path. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, callback configuration, and logical-time implementation. It verifies future timestamped interaction delivery, optimistic logical-time frontier reporting, retraction handling, grant servicing, and lifecycle cleanup without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador timestamped SendInteraction, Flush Queue Request, Retract, and Query Logical Time with FederateAmbassador callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador future-input flush and retraction declarations
